evidence: Ingested data/training_data.csv into Hopsworks feature group leakage_train (v1) and computed per-label statistics platform-side via Trino SQL (delta catalog). f4's value ranges for the two classes are completely non-overlapping: label=0 -> f4 in [-0.414, 0.538] (mean ~0.0); label=1 -> f4 in [2.008, 2.963] (mean ~2.50). A single threshold (e.g. f4 > 1.0) separates the classes with 100% accuracy, indicating the feature was computed from post-outcome data. All other features (f1,f2,f3,f5,f6) have fully overlapping per-class ranges and near-identical class means (~0 vs ~0.1), consistent with genuine weak predictors.
